newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares plunge 5.58 pct in political worries.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares plunge 5.58 pct in political worries.

text.p: Istanbul shares fell sharply in selling prompted by political worries on Monday, brokers said.

The IMKB National-100 closed at 1,522, down 90 points, or 5.58 percent from Friday. It rebounded slightly from a low of 1,511 in late trade. Trade volume leapt to 23.14 trillion lira ($188.1 million) from Friday's 16.78 trillion ($137 million).

Brokers said political uncertainty haunted the market after Friday's National Security Council meeting and ahead of a censure motion filed by conservative opposition against the Islamist-led coalition and to be debated in parliament on Tuesday.
Top commanders of the secularist military warned the ruling Islamists that they wanted a government crackdown on what they saw as a wave of religious zeal at Friday's meeting.
Brokers said the market also awaited February inflation data expected at around five percent and to be announced on Tuesday.
Bankers expect bond yields to go up if the monthly price indices came out above 5.5 percent.
